pedagogical_boundary: Neoplastic assets = product language after Andrzejewski representation. Tree assets = prologue after Bountis. Never authenticity scores or painting facsimiles.

citations.andrzejewski: Andrzejewski, D., Stork, D. G., Zhu, X., & Spronk, R. (2010). Inferring compositional style in the neo-plastic paintings of Piet Mondrian by machine learning. https://doi.org/10.1117/12.840558
citations.bountis: Bountis, Tassos, Athanassios S. Fokas, and Emmanouil Psarakis. 2017. “Fractal Analysis of Tree Paintings by Piet Mondrian (1872–1944).” International Journal of Arts and Technology. https://doi.org/10.1504/ijart.2017.083902
